content: आर्ष {%a.%} (-र्षी|{%f.%}) [ऋषेरिदम् अण्] .²1 Used by a Ṛṣi only, relating or belonging to sages, beneficial to sages; शमो दमस्तथा धैर्यं सत्यं शौचमथार्जवम् . यज्ञो घृतिश्च धर्मश्च नित्यमार्षो विधिः स्मृतः .. <ls>Mb. 12. 12. 17</ls>; archaic, Vedic (<ab>opp.</ab> लौकिक or classical); आर्षः प्रयोगः; संबुद्धौ शाकल्यस्येतावनार्षे <ls>P. I. 1. 16</ls> <ls>Sk.</ls>; आर्षो धर्मः <ls>Ms. 3. 29</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 59</ls>; आर्षः प्रत्ययः <ls>P. II. 4. 58</ls>. .²2 Sacred, holy, divine, superhuman; आदिकाव्यमिदं चार्षं पुरा वाल्मीकिना कृतम् <ls>Rām. 6. 128. 105</ls>; <ls>U. 6</ls>. .{@-र्षः@} A form of marriage derived from the Ṛṣis; one of the eight forms of marriage in which the father of the bride receives one or two pairs of cows from the bridegroom; आदायार्षस्तु गोद्वयम् <ls>Y. 1. 59</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 53</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 196</ls>; for the names of the 8 forms see उद्वाह; आर्षोढा a wife married according to this form. .{@-र्षा@} A class of Vedic metres. .{@-र्षम्@} .²1 The holy text, the Vedas; आर्षं धर्मोपदेशं च वेदशास्त्राविरोधिना <ls>Ms. 12. 106</ls>. .²2 Sacred descent. .²3 Derivation (of a poem) from a Ṛṣi author. {@आर्षंधरम्@} <ab>N.</ab> of a Sāman.
